q: Can a solar or wind power plant earn CCTS credits under BM EN01.001?
title: Renewable power under BM EN01.001
short: Not as a standalone grid-connected solar or wind plant: BM EN01.001 excludes those. It covers other grid-connected renewable plants, new or upgraded, and hybrids where solar or wind is paired with battery storage or pumped storage. It is adapted from the UN CDM method ACM0002.
audience: Renewable developers and factories with grid-connected generation

ul: Greenfield plants, capacity additions, retrofits, rehabilitation or replacement of renewable plants that supply the grid, excluding standalone grid-connected wind and solar in every case.
A greenfield renewable plant together with a new grid-connected pumped storage plant.
Hybrid systems that combine renewable technologies with a battery energy storage system (BESS) or pumped storage. Technologies other than standalone wind and solar qualify without storage too.
Adding a BESS to an existing solar PV or wind plant, with or without a capacity addition or retrofit.
Adapted from UNFCCC CDM methodology ACM0002 (version valid from 31 May 2024).
Sectoral scope: Energy. Version 1.0, adopted 27 March 2025.
Credits come from displacing grid electricity, so the grid emission factor tool BM-T-003 applies.

sections.h: What it means for a factory
p: A rooftop or ground solar plant exporting to the grid on its own does not qualify under this method. Pairing new solar with storage might, subject to additionality and the other conditions in the text.
